title: SEAR: A Multimodal Dataset for Analyzing AR-LLM-Driven Social Engineering Behaviors
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and benchmarking of a dataset for social engineering attacks (deception/phishing) using AR and LLMs. While it includes a mandatory section on ethical research safeguards and IRB compliance, and measures participant trust, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral philosophical systems.
